lf-diagram.description: A diagram rendered from a mermaid-source body (flowchart, sequence, state…). The body is data, not prose: text inside its <pre>, HTML-escaped (& first, then the angle brackets). A click comments on the whole diagram by default. Boxes listed in `parts` as `node:SOURCE_ID` take individual comments, where SOURCE_ID is the id written in the Mermaid source: the id of a node, a subgraph or a composite state in a flowchart or a `stateDiagram-v2`, or an `erDiagram` entity's name. Unlisted boxes and diagrams authored without `parts` keep the whole-diagram behavior. `parts` accepts only those three types, because they are the ones that carry a written id into the box they draw; every other type places its boxes by position, so declaring `parts` on one is a render error rather than a promise that cannot resolve. A sequence diagram gives its steps no id at all, so a drawing whose steps a reader should be able to point at is one of the three.
lf-diagram.x-example:
graph LR
  Cart --> Pay
  Pay --> Receipt
